summary: Extracted the remaining DeepSeek V3.2/DSA model-construction and pipeline top-k routing policy from deepseek_v2.py into deepseek_common/v32_mixin.py while preserving the existing DeepseekV2AttentionMLA, DeepseekV2Model, and model entry-point APIs. Added compatibility and adversarial coverage for non-DSA configurations, skip-topk and NextN layers, IndexerKPool arguments, MHA-versus-MLA routing, and pipeline-stage top-k boundaries.

tests.what_was_measured: 16 focused unit tests and 8 subtests covering the extracted V3.2 mixins and existing MLA dispatch compatibility. Raw output: reports/j-f0b2e1f03ee1/focused-final.log
Repository formatting, lint, syntax, spelling, safety, and registered-test metadata checks. Raw output: reports/j-f0b2e1f03ee1/pre-commit-final.log
The extracted empty pipeline top-k allocation preserves the assigned AMD MI350X device and produces int32 shape (0, 2048). This is a device-placement check, not a DeepSeek numerical accuracy claim.

gpu_execution.evidence: Assigned AMD Instinct MI350X exercised by the extracted pipeline top-k allocation; reports/j-f0b2e1f03ee1/v32-mixin-gpu.log records device, dtype, and shape. No tensor arithmetic moved in this Python-only refactor, so an independent numerical reference was not applicable.

remaining_limitations: No DeepSeek-V3.2 model weights were available, so full model serving, semantic accuracy, distributed pipeline parallel execution, and real Indexer/IndexerKPool kernel output were not qualified.
NVIDIA, NPU, CPU, MUSA, and multi-GPU paths were not executed; their compatibility is covered only by preserving call signatures and hermetic policy tests.

The broader issue's proposed dedicated NPU and CPU hardware mixins and its optional further attention-method abstraction are not implemented here. Existing completed upstream refactors already cover MHA, MLA, backend routing, ROCm, weight loading, and utilities; this contribution addresses the checklist's remaining V3.2 extraction only.
No native source changed, repository-environment.json declares no prepared native rebuild target, and no native rebuild was performed.
